Based on the evidence at hand, none of the authors of the paper appears to have an ORCID record that lists a 2023 paper in which they are the first author. # Interacting Dark Energy and Dark Matter: Observational Constraints from Cosmological Parameters - INSPIRE
## Interacting Dark Energy and Dark Matter: Observational Constraints from Cosmological Parameters
### Citations per year
Abstract: (Elsevier)
Several observational constraints are imposed on the interacting holographic model of dark energy and dark matter. First we use the age parameter today, as given by the WMAP results. Subsequently, we explained the reason why it is possible, as recently observed, for an old quasar to be observed in early stages of the Universe. We discuss this question in terms of the evolution of the age parameter as well as in terms of the structure formation. Finally, we give a detailed discussion of the constraints implied by the observed CMB low ℓ suppression. As a result, the interacting holographic model has been proved to be robust and with reasonable bounds predicts a non-vanishing interaction of dark energy and dark matter.

# Interacting Dark Energy and Dark Matter: Observational Constraints from Cosmological Parameters - INSPIRE
## Interacting Dark Energy and Dark Matter: Observational Constraints from Cosmological Parameters
### Citations per year
Abstract: (Elsevier)
Several observational constraints are imposed on the interacting holographic model of dark energy and dark matter. First we use the age parameter today, as given by the WMAP results. Subsequently, we explained the reason why it is possible, as recently observed, for an old quasar to be observed in early stages of the Universe. We discuss this question in terms of the evolution of the age parameter as well as in terms of the structure formation. Finally, we give a detailed discussion of the constraints implied by the observed CMB low ℓ suppression. As a result, the interacting holographic model has been proved to be robust and with reasonable bounds predicts a non-vanishing interaction of dark energy and dark matter.

Here at IQ, we’re honoured that so many wonderful writers decide to submit their work to us. This gives us the chance to work with some truly amazing talents, from non-fiction bestsellers to writing coaches, Guardian ‘top 10’ authors and social commentary journalists… amongst many others!
This page is where you can learn more about each person in the IQ family by clicking on their headshot above. On the author’s dedicated info page, you will be able to find out a bit about them (in their own words!) as well as their personal website and social media handles (if they have them).
Having a list of authors to choose from might be a bit daunting, which is why we’ve included a handy filter at the top of the page so you can match an author against the genre(s) to narrow down your search. If you’re looking for the best way to get in touch with any of the IQ authors, you can either do so by finding their social links (on their author pages), or filling in the contact form here on the Inspired Quill website, and we’d be happy to pass along your message if you let us know who it’s for.
